purpose: Preview fidelity pass — production backgrounds without text or baked controls

prompts.deployment: Production background plate for a detailed voxel military game's equipment deployment menu. Single clean full-bleed 16:9 environment image, no UI. Cool steel blue grey overcast industrial staging yard: ruined concrete factory walls on the sides, watchtower on the right, low olive cargo crates in foreground corners, barricades and distant smokestacks. Damp concrete ground. The middle 55 percent is a broad EMPTY standing area for live 3D character overlays, clear ground in lower third. Camera human chest height, level horizon. Physically-lit fine voxel/block-built architecture, subtle atmospheric perspective, soft bright cloud light, restrained blue-grey and olive palette. Background luminous and readable, not black. No humans, soldiers, weapons, text, symbols, numbers, panels, buttons, UI, HUD or watermarks.
prompts.solo: Production hero banner texture for a detailed voxel military extraction game menu. Full-bleed wide 21:9 image. An intricately detailed small-voxel military survivor from behind, olive helmet, large packed tactical rucksack, standing slightly RIGHT of center in a derelict industrial city at warm golden sunset, rifle pointed down at his side. Fully visible survivor about 65% image height. Cargo crates, overgrown pavement, broken concrete towers, pipes and high overhead industrial bridges recede toward sun at right. LEFT 40% has only a dark industrial wall and crates, low visual contrast, reserved for live typography. Warm amber and charcoal, cinematic physical lighting, sophisticated voxel realism. Artwork only: no words, glyphs, logos, UI, buttons, HUD, borders or watermark.
prompts.modes: A single production TEXTURE ATLAS for six military voxel game mode cards, EXACTLY 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, six rectangular panels edge to edge with NO gutters/borders. Very wide 3:1 aspect ratio, each panel landscape 2:1. Fine-voxel built industrial city ruins in consistent charcoal and golden evening light, cinematic realistic materials. TOP LEFT tank advancing through ruined industrial street. TOP MIDDLE two olive soldiers fighting distant opponents in factory street. TOP RIGHT deserted bombsite courtyard with cargo containers and crates. BOTTOM LEFT several separated soldiers facing different directions in city ruins, everyone fights independently. BOTTOM MIDDLE olive tactical soldier holding detailed assault rifle in industrial alley. BOTTOM RIGHT fortified concrete base with glowing blue energy core and defensive tower. Pure pictorial art only; absolutely NO words, lettering, numbers, badges, menus, UI, HUD, captions, or watermark. Grid edges exactly at one third and two thirds width and halfway height.
